description: Pedestrian routing (P0-09, P0-10, P0-12): RoutingService reads intramuros_graph.json, runs pure-Dart Dijkstra over DIRECTED edges weighted by length_m, reconstructs ordered edge geometry, sums distance, and returns a RouteResult (available or first-class unavailable — never a straight line). Depends on FEAT-001 because it imports package:tuntun/shared/models/route_result.dart.
steps: Read .agents/tasks/plan.md 'routing_service.dart' API block and the intramuros_graph.json contract in context.json (3268 nodes, 7245 DIRECTED edges, 5 one-way-only pairs, coord convention [lat,lon], all length_m>0). Confirm lib/shared/models/route_result.dart from FEAT-001 exists.

Create lib/features/navigation/routing_service.dart importing dart:convert, package:flutter/services.dart, package:tuntun/shared/models/route_result.dart. Private class _Edge{String to;double lengthM;List<GeoPoint> geometry}. Private array-based binary min-heap _MinHeap keyed by tentative distance with lazy deletion (dart:collection has no PQ).

Add factory RoutingService.fromDecodedJson(Map<String,dynamic> json): validate nodes {id,lat,lon} unique non-blank ids finite coords; edges {from,to,length_m,geometry} with length_m finite and >0, from/to known node ids, geometry non-empty list of [lat,lon] pairs; FormatException otherwise. Build DIRECTED adjacency: add each edge to _adjacency[from] ONLY — never the reverse.
Add factory RoutingService.fromJsonString(String) and static Future<RoutingService> load() using rootBundle.loadString(graphAsset). Add bool hasNode(String id).

Add RouteResult findRoute(String startNodeId,String destinationNodeId): throw FormatException if either id unknown; if start==destination return available single-point [node coord] distance 0.0; run Dijkstra over DIRECTED edges weighted by length_m with _MinHeap; if destination unreachable return RouteResult.unavailable() (NEVER a straight line); on success reconstruct ordered node path, concatenate each traversed edge geometry IN TRAVERSAL ORDER de-duplicating the shared junction vertex, sum length_m for distanceMeters, return RouteResult.available(...).

Create test/routing_service_test.dart: hand-made tiny graph via fromDecodedJson asserting shortest-path node order, summed distance, geometry concatenation order with shared-vertex de-dup, one-way edge NOT traversable backward (reverse => unavailable), disconnected pair => unavailable, start==destination => available single-point zero-distance, unknown node id => throwsFormatException; REAL case loading assets/maps/intramuros_graph.json + assets/landmarks/landmarks.json via dart:io File(...), routing fort-santiago node 1034882636 -> puerta-real node 9834302082, asserting isAvailable, distanceMeters>0, geometry length>=2, etaMinutes>0.
acceptance_criteria: flutter test test/routing_service_test.dart passes all synthetic cases AND the real-asset fort-santiago -> puerta-real case returning an available route with distanceMeters>0 and ordered geometry
One-way edges are not traversable backward and a disconnected valid pair yields RouteResult.unavailable() (no straight-line fallback); unknown node ids throw FormatException
findings:
Created lib/features/navigation/routing_service.dart (imports dart:convert, package:flutter/services.dart, package:tuntun/shared/models/route_result.dart only — no new packages/dirs/network/db) and test/routing_service_test.dart. Exported API matches plan.md exactly:
- class RoutingService with private const RoutingService._(nodes, adjacency); static const String graphAsset = 'assets/maps/intramuros_graph.json'.
- factory RoutingService.fromDecodedJson(Map<String,dynamic> json): validates nodes {id,lat,lon} unique non-blank ids + finite coords, edges {from,to,length_m,geometry} with length_m finite and >0, from/to known node ids, geometry non-empty list of [lat,lon] pairs; FormatException on any violation. Builds DIRECTED adjacency: each edge added to _adjacency[from] ONLY (never the reverse) — verified by the one-way backward-unavailable test.
- factory RoutingService.fromJsonString(String); static Future<RoutingService> load() via rootBundle.loadString(graphAsset); bool hasNode(String id).
- RouteResult findRoute(String startNodeId, String destinationNodeId): unknown id => FormatException; start==destination => RouteResult.available single-point [node coord] distance 0.0; valid-but-disconnected => RouteResult.unavailable() (NEVER straight line); success reconstructs ordered node path, concatenates each traversed edge geometry IN TRAVERSAL ORDER with shared-junction-vertex de-dup, sums length_m. Dijkstra uses private _Edge{to,lengthM,geometry} and a private array-based binary min-heap _MinHeap (push/pop/isEmpty) with lazy deletion (dart:collection has no PQ).

Verification actually run from repo root:
- `flutter analyze lib/features/navigation/routing_service.dart` => No issues found! (0.4s).
- `flutter test test/routing_service_test.dart` => All tests passed (9 tests). Synthetic cases cover shortest-path node order (A->B->C 20m over direct A->C 30m), summed distance, geometry concat order + shared-vertex de-dup, one-way edge not traversable backward (reverse => unavailable), disconnected pair => unavailable (empty geometry, distance 0), start==destination => available single-point zero-distance, unknown node id => throwsFormatException, hasNode, and malformed-graph rejection. REAL case loads assets/maps/intramuros_graph.json (3268 nodes, 7245 directed edges) + assets/landmarks/landmarks.json via dart:io File(...) and routes fort-santiago node 1034882636 -> puerta-real node 9834302082: isAvailable true, distanceMeters>0, geometry length>=2, etaMinutes>0.
NOT run (out of this feature's scope): Android release build and airplane-mode cold-launch (device verification is a later integration/proof step).
